name: Comprehensive Crypto Removal from News Scanner (Phase 2)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-19: 'we need to get rid of any and all crypto news sources from the news scanner process [...] we're still seeing crypto news dominating' despite the 2026-05-12 fix (commit c72c9368a) which cut INGESTION + added SOURCE BLOCKLIST + RECENCY FLOOR. Defense-in-depth gap: prior fix did NOT remove crypto from the RANKING / NORMALIZATION / GPT-PROMPTING layers. Non-blocked sources (TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Reuters, Yahoo Finance, MarketWatch, CNBC) all cover crypto news -- those stories still flow through Layer 2 -> Layer 3, get normalized into crypto/bitcoin keyword buckets via KEYWORD_NORMALIZATION, and are explicitly prompted as preferred portal keywords. This project tears out crypto presence at all 4 layers structurally: TOP_20_KEYWORDS removal, KEYWORD_NORMALIZATION crypto-variant block removal, BLOCKED_SOURCES extension + threshold reduction, CRYPTO_CAP -> BANNED_KEYWORDS hard-drop-at-prefilter conversion, content-level CRYPTO_RAW_PATTERN regex filter, comprehensive GPT prompt scrub including explicit EXCLUSION instruction.
phase: ADHC_CRYPCT.001 FUNCTIONALLY COMPLETE 2026-05-20. Comprehensive 4-layer crypto removal shipped + deployed -- news-v2.9.8 + v2.9.9 + v2.9.10 all landed 2026-05-19 (committed + pushed + S3 + Lambda via terraform apply; opal-news-layer3-curation live 2026-05-19T17:01:56Z, v2.9.10 SHA = commit efe281914). +24h verification window (2026-05-19T17:01:56Z -> 2026-05-20T17:01:56Z) result: portal latest.json 18/20 topics fully clean, ZERO crypto-dominant clusters (pre-fix worst was 4-of-6). DS surfaced 2 minor residual paths (stray crypto-pub articles inside diluted/legit clusters) + recommended a v2.9.11; Andrew ruled DIRECT 2026-05-20 that this residual is a NON-ISSUE -- crypto from a non-crypto-dedicated source is acceptable; the directive only ever targeted the ~10 crypto-spam-only publications, which are handled. v2.9.11 / ADHC_CRYPCT.002 CANCELLED (TO retained cancelled-with-note for the GO-then-veto audit trail). 3-step project closure (JSON/REGISTRY/PRD) PARKED -- Andrew deprioritized 2026-05-20 ('bigger fish to fry'); carried as a 1.0.0_SA_CTO housekeeping item, fired when Andrew clears bandwidth.
blocking: None -- .001 functionally complete; v2.9.11/.002 cancelled (Andrew-direct veto). 3-step closure parked as a CTO housekeeping item.
pipeline: news-pipeline (news_layer3_curation Lambda primary + news_trending_analysis Lambda audit)
